summary.order: controls first, then mutants, each sorted by id; the pool's completion order does not reach this file
summary.parallelNote: The compiles are independent, so they run in a pool of 4. The cap is memory, not cores: each lean process holds several GB with Mathlib imported. lake env lean type-checks a copy outside the package, writing no .olean, and each compile also has its own directory under the scratch root, so none can clobber another. lean's own elaboration threads are capped at 8 per compile (LEAN_NUM_THREADS) so the pool does not oversubscribe 32 cores; wall clock against summed compile time is the speedup.
